{{Quote|How did you get over here?''"<br />"''I improvised.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, remarking on the latter's sudden arrival in the south tower|audio=Improvised-THE.flac|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />}}
A '''double-towered business center''' overlooked a major plaza within [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The complex was comprised of two towers, one facing the north and the other situated to the south.

==History==
{{Quote|This is Sergeant Slick reporting to Generals Kenobi and Skywalker. We have a candidate for an ambush site. Gus and Jester are checking it out. Double-towered business center with clear view of a major plaza.|[[Slick/Legends|Sergeant Slick]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>}}
The two towers overlooked the main plaza of the city, and were an ideal place for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to ambush the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] army going through the plaza during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] were stationed in the north tower while [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] were stationed in the south tower. Kenobi's men reported that the droid army unexpectedly split into two.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />

Suddenly, battle droids swarmed the south tower, and the clones' positions were compromised. Skywalker and his men made their way into the south tower by using ascension cables in the gap between the two buildings, and the survivors proceeded to the extraction point on the roof of the building.<ref name="The Hidden Enemy" />
